items.title: Being Jacobson is a local property on an open covering
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the locality of the Jacobson property on an open covering (author lemma at source lines 3588-3594, label lemma-jacobson-local), including the identity X_0 = union of the U_{i,0}. The proof (source lines 3596-3639) is not the routine sheaf-theoretic locality argument: the author first records that the containment of closed-point sets can be strict for a single member of the covering (proof lines 3599-3601), and then recovers equality by a genuine case analysis on the closure of a point that is closed in one member of the covering and the way that closure meets the other members (proof lines 3604-3612). The converse direction is then formal, and the union statement is the by-product that the section uses. H2.
